title: Jensen Huang agrees to face Congress over Nvidia scandal
source: Axios — Jensen Huang agrees to face Congress over Nvidia scandal (2026-11-17)
body: Jensen Huang and Nvidia general counsel Tim Teter will officially testify before Congress in early December, lawmakers announced Tuesday. Why it matters: Lawmakers are seeking answers about whether Nvidia's powerful AI chips were compromised by Chinese intelligence and whether the company did enough to protect sensitive American technology. Huang and Teter will participate in transcribed, closed-door interviews with the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence and China select committees. What they're saying: "We look forward to hearing from Jensen Huang and Tim Teter on their roles in a potential breach of our national security," said the chairman of those committees in a release . What's next: Huang will appear before the committees on Dec. 1, and Teter will appear on Dec. 2. Editor's note: This is breaking news and will be updated.
